name: Jimra
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Jimra was a son of Sotlah and a descendant of the tribe of Asher. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogy of Asher's descendants. He was one of the tribal heads and counted among skilled warriors.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Asher's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jimra is recorded as a son of Sotlah in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Counted Among Tribal Heads
keyEvents.description: Jimra and his relatives were regarded as heads of their families and skilled warriors among the descendants of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Part of Asher's military muster
keyEvents.description: Asher's descendants, including the family of Jimra, were counted as warriors, totaling 26,000 men.

keyEvents.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Asher, Jimra was among those who received their allotted portion in the Promised Land west of Galilee.
